active_chains.title: The Iran Squeeze — India Realignment

key_facts.event: 25% secondary tariffs on Iran buyers (effective 7 Feb). 30-day nuclear ultimatum. Dual carrier strike group in Persian Gulf.
key_facts.india_pivot: India committed to stop buying Russian oil. $500bn US purchase commitment over 5 years. Reciprocal tariff reduced to 18%.
key_facts.oil: Brent ~$70, up 14% YTD on geopolitical premium
key_facts.venezuela: US issued Reliance licence for direct Venezuelan crude purchase
key_facts.russia_impact: GDP 0.6%, losing Indian oil customer, central bank cut to 15.5%

predictions.prediction: If Iran talks fail by early March, oil tests $80+
If deal reached, sharp reversal — geopolitical premium unwinds 8-12% in days
Watch for India's first major US weapons purchase announcement as confirmation of realignment

watch_items: Iran response to 30-day ultimatum (~early March deadline)

active_chains.title: European Rearmament Acceleration + UK-EU Pivot

key_facts.munich: MSC Feb 13-15. Rubio: 'The Old World is Gone'. Theme: 'Under Destruction'.
key_facts.germany: Military warns compressed timelines for conflict readiness
key_facts.uk: £545M hypersonic weapons commitment. Starmer pivoting toward EU single market. Prepared to deploy peacekeepers to Ukraine if ceasefire.
key_facts.eu: Buy European procurement push debated at Brussels summit

predictions.prediction: European defence remains strongest secular trade — BAE, Rheinmetall, Leonardo, Thales, Saab multi-year tailwinds
Second-order plays less priced in: specialty chemicals, cybersecurity, construction/engineering
EU defence procurement reform proposals expected Q2 2026
Starmer EU pivot = structural GBP strengthening if concrete policy follows. FTSE 250 outperforms FTSE 100.

watch_items: German debt brake modification for defence
Concrete Starmer single market proposals vs rhetoric

active_chains.title: Russia-Ukraine Peace Talks + War Economy Deterioration

key_facts.talks: US-brokered trilateral Geneva talks Feb 17-18. 20-point plan. Sticking points: Donbas free economic zone, energy infrastructure strike moratorium.
key_facts.russia_economy: GDP 0.6%, rate cut to 15.5%, 1.245M casualties, advance rate 15-70m/day (slowest in a century)
key_facts.ukraine: Active defence posture, PURL initiative raised $4.5bn, localised advances in Hulyaipole direction

predictions.prediction: Geneva produces framework/agreement to continue — not a ceasefire. Modest rally (Euro gas -3-5%, European equities +1-2%) then drift back.
European energy reconfiguration is permanent regardless of peace outcome
Russia's negotiating position weakens over time as India oil exit + low growth + high casualties compound

watch_items: Geneva outcomes Feb 17-18 — energy infrastructure moratorium = serious, vague framework = posturing

active_chains.title: Warsh Fed Chair — Cross-Asset Cascade

key_facts.appointment: Kevin Warsh named next Fed Chair (replacing Powell in May). Known hawk.
key_facts.market_reaction: Gold -4%, silver -5%, oil -4%, copper -4%. CME margin hike triggered liquidation cascade.
key_facts.context: Gold/silver had rallied 30%/71% to records in January — parabolic and overextended.
key_facts.rates: US inflation sticky at 2.4%. BoE held 3.75% (5-4 split). ECB held. Synchronised hawkish shift globally.
key_facts.boe_detail: 4 members voted for cut — March cut probability jumped to ~50%

predictions.prediction: Commodity unwind has further to go. Gold to test $2,400-2,500 (from ~$2,900 highs).
Equities outperform commodities next quarter. Banks cleanest play on Warsh regime.
If CPI stays sticky, Warsh more hawkish than expected — cascade continues.

watch_items: Gold price trajectory — parabolic breaks overshoot downside
BoE March decision (19 March) — cut now ~50% probability
Warsh confirmation hearings and policy signals
historical_parallels_cited: Volcker 1979 — hawkish appointment, immediate commodity pain, equity-positive 18-24mo

global_context.fed_rate: current rate TBD — Powell still chair until May
